description: Shared corridor approach to a T-junction. The current RGB decision frame is identical for both goals; the goal image selects LEFT vs RIGHT branch. A goal-blind policy sees one observation and cannot satisfy both branches.
coordinate_note: Scene-local metres, design intent. To be mapped to hospital.usd nav coordinates at collection. yaw_deg measured CCW from world +x; robot heads +x down the corridor.

decision_point.note: At the T-junction facing the far wall; must branch left or right. This pose defines the single shared decision frame o_d used for both goals.
